GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Grafana admin password — auto-generated. Save it after deploy.

GF_SECURITY_SECRET_KEY.description: Session encryption key — auto-generated. Changing it invalidates all sessions.

GF_SERVER_HTTP_PORT.description: HTTP listen port (must match PORT and EXPOSE in Dockerfile)

GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL.description: Public-facing URL — uses Railway domain. Required for correct redirects.

GF_PATHS_DATA.description: Persistent data directory (must match volume mount path)

GF_PATHS_PLUGINS.description: Plugins install directory (must be on persistent volume)

GF_SECURITY_ALLOW_EMBEDDING.description: Allow Grafana dashboards to be embedded in iframes

RAILWAY_RUN_UID.description: Run as root so entrypoint can chown the volume at startup. Grafana's /run.sh drops to UID 472 internally.
